summary: Backend-only testing of Scheduled Campaign background worker feature. All 13 tests passed (100%). The scheduler correctly picks up campaigns with status='scheduled' and past scheduled_at time, creates queue items with correct 'queue_id' field (not queue_item_id), and changes status to 'running'. The schedule/unschedule endpoints work as expected.
passed_tests: Creating campaign with scheduled_at auto-sets status to 'scheduled'
/api/campaigns/{id}/unschedule returns status to 'draft' and clears scheduled_at
Schedule endpoint fails when no scheduled_at is set (400)
Queue items created with correct 'queue_id' field (not queue_item_id) - BUG FIX VERIFIED
Scheduler runs every 30 seconds and picks up due campaigns
Schedule endpoint validates list_id is required
Schedule endpoint validates subject is required
critical_code_review_comments: Scheduler implementation is correct - uses asyncio.sleep(30) for 30-second intervals
Queue items correctly use 'queue_id' field (line 229): queue_id = f"q_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
start_scheduled_campaign() properly validates: email accounts, email list existence, non-empty list
Duplicate queue prevention with existing_queue check (line 223)
Error handling is comprehensive with proper logging and status updates to 'failed'
seed_data_creation: Created temporary test email lists, accounts, campaigns, and sessions for testing - all cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scheduled campaigns feature fully tested and working. Key findings: 1) When creating a campaign with scheduled_at, status is auto-set to 'scheduled' (not 'draft'). 2) The scheduler runs every 30 seconds checking for campaigns with status='scheduled' and scheduled_at in the past. 3) When scheduler picks up a campaign, it creates queue items with 'queue_id' field (the bug fix was verified - no 'queue_item_id' field used). 4) Campaign status changes from 'scheduled' -> 'running' -> 'completed'. 5) The /api/campaigns/{id}/schedule endpoint is used to manually schedule a draft campaign. 6) The /api/campaigns/{id}/unschedule endpoint returns a scheduled campaign to 'draft' and clears scheduled_at.
